tha-ap376:1.1: samattaṃ. [371. Pattipupphiyo.] Yadā nibbāyi sambuddho mahesi Padumuttaro / samāgamma janā sabbe sarīraṃ nīharanti te. // //
tha-ap376:2.1: Nīharante sarīramhi vajjamānāsu bherisu / pasannacitto sumano pattipuppham apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap376:3.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sarīre pūjite phalaṃ.
tha-ap376:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pattipupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
